people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
translations.bsb: These nations were left to test the Israelites, to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the LORD, which He had given their fathers through Moses.
translations.kjv: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
translations.asv: And they were left, to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
